table_counts.sql: SELECT 'bronze_claim_events_mvp2' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.bronze_claim_events_mvp2 UNION ALL SELECT 'mvp2_processing_queue' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_queue UNION ALL SELECT 'mvp2_processing_decisions' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_decisions UNION ALL SELECT 'silver_claims_current_mvp2' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.silver_claims_current_mvp2 UNION ALL SELECT 'quarantine_claim_events_mvp2' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.quarantine_claim_events_mvp2 UNION ALL SELECT 'mvp2_event_processing_ledger' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_event_processing_ledger UNION ALL SELECT 'mvp2_batch_audit' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_batch_audit

bronze_batches.sql: SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(source_file, '[^/]+$', 0) AS file_name, COUNT(*) AS incoming_count, COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS distinct_event_ids FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.bronze_claim_events_mvp2 GROUP BY source_file ORDER BY file_name

decision_outcomes.sql: SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(source_file, '[^/]+$', 0) AS file_name, processing_status, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_decisions GROUP BY source_file,processing_status ORDER BY file_name,processing_status

ledger_outcomes.sql: SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(source_file, '[^/]+$', 0) AS file_name, processing_status, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_event_processing_ledger GROUP BY source_file,processing_status ORDER BY file_name,processing_status

quarantine_reasons.sql: SELECT rejection_reason, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT_IF(paid_amount='NOT_A_NUMBER') AS invalid_payment_preserved FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.quarantine_claim_events_mvp2 GROUP BY rejection_reason ORDER BY rejection_reason

silver_state.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(claim_id,segment)) AS distinct_keys, COUNT_IF(event_version=2 AND operation='UPDATE') AS version2_corrections, COUNT_IF(paid_amount IS NULL) AS missing_payments, COUNT_IF(paid_amount < 0) AS negative_payments, COUNT_IF(paid_amount=0) AS zero_payments, SUM(paid_amount) AS payment_total FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.silver_claims_current_mvp2

audit_rows.sql: SELECT batch_name,incoming_count,merged_count,quarantined_count,ignored_count,silver_row_count,silver_payment_total,audit_status,CAST(audited_at AS STRING) AS audited_at FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_batch_audit ORDER BY batch_name

delivery_grains.sql: SELECT 'bronze_claim_events_mvp2' AS table_name, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(source_file,event_id)) AS repeated_delivery_keys, COUNT_IF(source_file IS NULL OR event_id IS NULL OR TRIM(event_id)='') AS missing_delivery_keys FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.bronze_claim_events_mvp2 UNION ALL SELECT 'mvp2_processing_queue' AS table_name, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(source_file,event_id)) AS repeated_delivery_keys, COUNT_IF(source_file IS NULL OR event_id IS NULL OR TRIM(event_id)='') AS missing_delivery_keys FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_queue UNION ALL SELECT 'mvp2_processing_decisions' AS table_name, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(source_file,event_id)) AS repeated_delivery_keys, COUNT_IF(source_file IS NULL OR event_id IS NULL OR TRIM(event_id)='') AS missing_delivery_keys FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_decisions UNION ALL SELECT 'mvp2_event_processing_ledger' AS table_name, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(source_file,event_id)) AS repeated_delivery_keys, COUNT_IF(source_file IS NULL OR event_id IS NULL OR TRIM(event_id)='') AS missing_delivery_keys FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_event_processing_ledger UNION ALL SELECT 'quarantine_claim_events_mvp2' AS table_name, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(source_file,event_id)) AS repeated_delivery_keys, COUNT_IF(source_file IS NULL OR event_id IS NULL OR TRIM(event_id)='') AS missing_delivery_keys FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.quarantine_claim_events_mvp2

backlogs.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_queue LEFT ANTI JOIN workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_decisions USING(source_file,event_id)) AS unclassified_queue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_decisions LEFT ANTI JOIN workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_event_processing_ledger USING(source_file,event_id)) AS unfinished_decisions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.bronze_claim_events_mvp2 LEFT ANTI JOIN workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_queue USING(source_file,event_id)) AS unstaged_bronze

ledger_reconciliation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_processing_decisions d LEFT JOIN workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_event_processing_ledger l USING(source_file,event_id) WHERE NOT (l.processing_status <=> CASE WHEN d.processing_status='READY_FOR_MERGE' THEN 'MERGED' WHEN d.processing_status LIKE 'REJECT_%' THEN 'QUARANTINED' WHEN d.processing_status='IGNORE_DUPLICATE_EVENT' THEN 'IGNORED_DUPLICATE' ELSE d.processing_status END)

correction_payments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS corrections_matched_to_base, COUNT_IF(s.event_version=2 AND s.operation='UPDATE' AND s.paid_amount=TRY_CAST(b.CLM_PMT_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,2))+100) AS correct_plus_100, SUM(s.paid_amount-TRY_CAST(b.CLM_PMT_AMT AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS net_change FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.silver_claims_current_mvp2 s JOIN workspace.claimsinsight.bronze_inpatient b ON s.claim_id=b.CLM_ID AND s.segment=TRY_CAST(b.SEGMENT AS INT) WHERE s.event_id LIKE 'CMS_CORR_%'

audit_reconciliation.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(source_file,'[^/]+$',0) batch_name,COUNT(*) incoming_count,COUNT_IF(processing_status='MERGED') merged_count,COUNT_IF(processing_status='QUARANTINED') quarantined_count,COUNT_IF(processing_status NOT IN ('MERGED','QUARANTINED')) ignored_count FROM workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_event_processing_ledger GROUP BY source_file) SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatched_files FROM counts c FULL OUTER JOIN workspace.claimsinsight_cms_mvp2.mvp2_batch_audit a USING(batch_name) WHERE NOT(c.incoming_count <=> a.incoming_count) OR NOT(c.merged_count <=> a.merged_count) OR NOT(c.quarantined_count <=> a.quarantined_count) OR NOT(c.ignored_count <=> a.ignored_count) OR a.audit_status != 'RECONCILED'

source_years.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(CLM_FROM_DT,1,4) AS claim_start_year,COUNT(*) AS rows FROM workspace.claimsinsight.bronze_inpatient GROUP BY SUBSTRING(CLM_FROM_DT,1,4) ORDER BY claim_start_year
